steps.title: Set up new Android project
steps.description: Initialize a new Android project with the specified app name and package name, configuring basic project settings.

steps.title: Define UI layout for Main Activity
steps.description: Create the layout for the main screen, including elements for phone number input, call controls, status, and timer.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity UI logic
steps.description: Add Java code to MainActivity to handle UI interactions, display call status, and manage the countdown timer.

steps.title: Define UI layout for Settings Activity
steps.description: Design the layout for the Settings screen, allowing users to input, save, view, and clear their Gemini API key.

steps.title: Implement Settings Activity logic
steps.description: Develop Java code for SettingsActivity to manage Gemini API key input, secure storage using SharedPreferences, and UI feedback.

steps.title: Implement Gemini API Client
steps.description: Create a utility class to handle communication with the Gemini API, including sending text and receiving AI responses using HttpURLConnection.

steps.title: Integrate Speech Recognition (User Input)
steps.description: Add functionality to MainActivity to convert user's spoken input to text using Android's SpeechRecognizer.

steps.title: Integrate Text-to-Speech (AI Output)
steps.description: Implement TextToSpeech in MainActivity to convert Gemini's text responses into spoken audio for the user.

steps.title: Handle Runtime Permissions
steps.description: Implement runtime permission requests for CALL_PHONE and RECORD_AUDIO to ensure the app can function correctly and securely.

steps.title: Implement Call Initiation and Simulation
steps.description: Develop the 'Start AI Call' and 'End Call' logic, including initiating a standard phone call, displaying the safety notice, managing the call timer, and simulating AI conversation independent of the cellular audio stream.

steps.title: Add Disclaimer for Telephony Limitations
steps.description: Ensure a clear disclaimer is presented to the user regarding the limitations of integrating AI audio directly into cellular calls via public Android APIs.

steps.title: Refine UI and UX
steps.description: Make final adjustments to layouts and Java code for a clean, responsive UI and good user experience, including proper error handling and progress indicators.

steps.title: Building AI Voice Caller
steps.description: Compile and assemble the debug APK of the AI Voice Caller application.
